apduFormat.desc: Instruction class - indicates the command type, e.g., interindustry or proprietary.
Instruction code - indicates a specific command, e.g., "select," "write data."
Instruction parameters for the command, e.g., offset into a file at which to write the data.

Encodes the number (Nc) of bytes of command data to follow. 0 bytes denote Nc=0; 1 byte with a value from 1 to 255 denotes Nc with the same length; 3 bytes, the first of which must be 0, denotes Nc in the range 1 to 65535 (all three bytes may not be zero).

Encodes the maximum number (Ne) of response bytes expected. 0 bytes denote Ne=0; 1 byte in the range 1 to 255 denotes that value of Ne, or 0 denotes Ne=256; 2 bytes (if extended Lc was present in the command) in the range 1 to 65535 denotes Ne of that value, or two zero bytes denotes 65536; 3 bytes (if Lc was not present in the command), the first of which must be 0, denote Ne in the same way as the two-byte Le.
Command processing status, e.g., 90 00 (hexadecimal), indicates success.

Current Token Data. Jettons: Decimal (4), Jetton Code Length JCL (2), Jetton Code (JCL), Jetton Code Max Depth (2), State assembler of the Jetton (1), Ticker Name (TDL-40).
Signature to all data used to check of data.

commands.name: REQUEST_SIGN_TOKEN_TX
commands.description: Initiates a token transaction signing sequence; provides the needed data to generate the signature. Operation type must equal 0 (simple send). Path MUST be under m/44'/607'/* with hardened steps only; otherwise PERMISSION_DENY. MUST be sent after START_SIGN_TOKEN_TX. (Detailed section only.)

inputData.desc: The number of steps in the path.
The i-th step in the path (after "m"), for i = 0 .. N-1.
The unique number added to the contract state when deployed, Big-endian.
Time limit for a transaction, Big-endian.
Sequence number of the Message, Big-endian.
Type of the operation. Must equal 0 (Simple Send).

Simple Send (type 0): per output message mode (1) + Len (2) + Data (L); each output message data = Bounceable (1), Destination Address Chain ID (1), Destination Address Hash (32), Amount Length (1), Amount (15), State Init Max Depth (2), State Init Hash (32), Body Type (1); Body type 0 Blind Sign; type 1 Comment; type 2 Transfer Jetton; type 3 Transfer NFT fields per the spec.

commands.name: CONFIRM_SIGN_TOKEN_TX
commands.description: Requests the user's confirmation of signing the token transaction. MUST be sent after REQUEST_SIGN_TOKEN_TX. (Detailed section only.)

commands.name: FINISH_SIGN_TOKEN_TX
commands.description: Finish a token transaction signing sequence. On reject returns DENY. MUST be sent after CONFIRM_SIGN_TX. (Detailed section only.)

outputData.desc: A 64-byte ED25519 signature.
A 32-byte SHA256.
